summary: PASS. Requirements 1-5 are implemented and covered: img src/srcset, source srcset, video poster become data URIs; CSS url() of images/fonts and @import (depth 3, cycle guard) are inlined for style blocks and linked stylesheets; outside pages use the session-file route with the new assetOf rule (evidenced .html owner, frozen image/css/font allowlist, lexical+realpath containment, dot segments, sensitive, root/home folder, UNC/device refused); limits 40 files / 20 MB / 5 s; no scripts, video/audio or style attributes; pop-out receives sessionTaskId. Low observation: url() inside a .css file is not treated as an asset itself, which matches the spec. Caveat: reviewer read source files and did not run tests.
